2025-11-22.cause: A six-week slide from the October 2025 record (about 126k) on spot-ETF outflows, fading odds of a December Fed cut and AI-equity doubts after Nvidia's Nov 20 earnings reversal; BTC hit about 80.5k on Friday Nov 21. The analog hour is the Saturday after that low.
2025-11-22.resolved: NY Fed President Williams said on Nov 21 there was 'room for a further adjustment in the near term'; December cut odds jumped above 70% and BTC bounced to about 86k at once and about 91k within the week. A policy-expectations rescue.

2026-02-01.cause: A weekend liquidation cascade after Trump nominated Kevin Warsh as Fed chair (read as hawkish) and a record precious-metals crash on Jan 30-31 forced margin calls across portfolios; spot ETFs had lost about $681M the week before. BTC fell below 76k, its first time under 80k since April 2025, with about $2.2B liquidated in 24h.
2026-02-01.resolved: Not within the week. The slide extended to about 60k on Thursday Feb 5 (the worst day since FTX, about $2.7B liquidated), and BTC then rebounded 11-15% on Feb 6. The low came 4 days later and about 20% lower.

2026-06-07.cause: The worst week since FTX (BTC -17%, ETH -22% in the week to Jun 6). A strong May payrolls print (172k vs 88k expected) lifted rates, spot ETFs had a 13-day outflow streak as money rotated to AI infrastructure and the SpaceX IPO, and Strategy made its first BTC sale in years to fund preferred dividends. The 2026 low was 59.1k on Jun 5-6.
2026-06-07.resolved: An 'oversold relief rally' over the 7-8 June weekend (+7.5% to about 63.8k) and an in-line May CPI on Jun 10 (core below forecast). The week ended slightly up, still range-bound.

2022-01-22.cause: Markets repriced faster Fed tightening ahead of the Jan 26 FOMC, alongside a global tech sell-off and Russia-Ukraine tension. BTC fell from about 40.7k on Jan 21 to about 34.3k on the weekend of Jan 22, about 50% below the November 2021 record: its worst week in 8 months.
2022-01-22.resolved: A final low near 33k on Monday Jan 24, when US stocks reversed intraday, then chop around the hawkish FOMC and a February rally toward 45k. The flush was the low of that leg, not of the bear market.

2023-03-11.cause: Silicon Valley Bank failed on Friday Mar 10, with part of Circle's USDC reserves inside it. USDC depegged to about $0.87 on Saturday Mar 11 and BTC traded under 20k.
2023-03-11.resolved: On Sunday Mar 12, the Fed, Treasury and FDIC backstopped all SVB deposits and created the Bank Term Funding Program. USDC repegged and BTC rallied about 19% in 72h and 31% in 7 days: an external policy rescue, the largest upside outcome in the set.

2024-07-06.cause: A supply overhang. The Mt. Gox estate began repaying creditors (47k BTC moved on Jul 5) while the German government sold seized BTC; BTC hit about 53.5k on Friday Jul 5, a four-month low.
2024-07-06.resolved: The German wallet was emptied around Jul 12 and many Mt. Gox coins were held rather than sold. BTC chopped for a week, then rallied to about 68k after the Jul 13 assassination attempt on Trump raised his election odds. The supply shock ended, and a political catalyst followed.

2022-06-14.cause: The crypto credit unwind after LUNA. Celsius froze withdrawals on Jun 12-13 and Three Arrows Capital was being liquidated, while the hot May CPI (Jun 10) set up a 75 bp Fed hike on Jun 15, the largest since 1994. BTC lost 20k.
2022-06-14.resolved: It did not resolve. After a brief post-FOMC bounce to about 22.5k, BTC made a new low at about 17.6k on Saturday Jun 18 as forced sellers dumped. The bear market's final low came only after FTX in November.

2025-11-15.cause: The start of the same November 2025 leg as analog #1. BTC broke below 95k on Friday Nov 14 (a six-month low) on the largest spot-ETF outflow since February ($867M on Nov 13), with December cut odds falling under 50%.
2025-11-15.resolved: Not within the week. The slide continued to about 80.5k on Nov 21, until the Williams comments of analog #1. This is the 'low still ahead' branch.

2025-02-27.cause: Three things at once: the Feb 21 Bybit hack (about $1.5B of ETH stolen, the largest ever), heavy spot-ETF outflows (about $2.1B in six days) and new tariff threats (25% on EU goods, Canada/Mexico tariffs due Mar 4). BTC fell below 83k on Feb 27 and to about 78-80k on Feb 28.
2025-02-27.resolved: On Sunday Mar 2, Trump posted about a US strategic crypto reserve and BTC spiked to about 94k. Most of that gain was given back within days once the tariffs took effect. The path ran through a squeeze and a reversal.

2022-05-12.cause: The Terra collapse. UST lost its peg from May 9 and LUNA went to about zero; the Luna Foundation Guard sold its BTC reserve, Tether briefly slipped under $0.99, and BTC hit about 26.7k on May 12, with more than $200B wiped from crypto in a day.
2022-05-12.resolved: Forced selling ended once the LFG reserve was spent and Terra halted its chain. BTC bounced to about 30k within days, then ranged until the June credit unwind (analog #7).

rules.rule: WHEN the market looks like a past episode (multi-scale analog search on price shape, vol percentile, drawdown, cell, funding, OI, weekend) THEN do not use what followed the analogs as a forecast of the next 24h/72h move size; use log-HAR-t x weekday
rules.when: an analog list or 'this looks like <date>' argument is offered for BTC
rules.then: move-size expectations come from the volatility tools (log-HAR-t x weekday, field card), not from analog outcomes
rules.effect: QLIKE analog minus HAR: 24h in-sample +0.288 (t +6.3), holdout +0.399 (t +1.4); 72h in-sample +0.279 (t +4.4), holdout +0.110 (t +0.8); verdicts contradicts / inconclusive
rules.review: a registered analog variant with QLIKE t < -2 vs log-HAR-t in both segments

rules.rule: WHEN reading the direction of past analogs THEN treat their up/down split as no information about the next 24h/72h sign
rules.when: analog up-share is quoted as a direction call
rules.then: no directional weight from analogs; the sign stays at the base rate
rules.review: Brier skill CI above 0 in both segments for a registered variant

rules.rule: WHEN BTC is in a weekend post-crash state like 2026-11-15 (R9, 30d drawdown > 20%, rv pct > 0.95, funding pct < 0.1) THEN expect a two-branch week (policy or relief rebound vs a further leg down days later), not a known direction
rules.when: cell R9, dd30 < -0.20, rv_pct > 0.95, funding_pct < 0.10, weekend
rules.then: plan for both branches; the 24h low being undercut within the week is common; no edge in either direction from the analogs
rules.effect: 20 combined analogs (chosen after seeing today): 7d median +3.9%, q10 -8.8%, q90 +7.9%, up 70%; unconditional median +0.5%; trailing 24h low undercut within 7d 12/20
rules.review: descriptive only; retire if the forward sample of such states shows a consistent direction
